summary: Design + validate slew-smoothed gate corrections (0.15.4.2 candidate): no torque discontinuities under hand interaction, all prior wins preserved

design.summary: Hand-interaction roughness on fw 0.15.4.1 is now expressible in the sim (--forced-rock/--forced-hold with per-tick |dI|/|dOutput| max+p99 banner metrics), quantified (rocking slams I by 79-105M pre-shift counts in ONE 32-microsecond tick = a 40-52k-count full rail-to-rail output/torque reversal at EVERY amplitude 5k-90k and frequency 0.5-2 Hz; ki=0 floor is 1.7-2.4k @d-shift5 / 450-600 @d-shift7; holds ramp rail-to-full at the raw error*ki rate, 20 ms at a 5k-count offset), and fixed by a two-part smoothing candidate. Winner: C3 = --i-gate-slew 4 (crossing/stale corrections become a TARGET that I slews toward at max_integral_term_full>>4 = 6.55M/tick, with freeze-unwind running in parallel and no snap-back when unwind passes the target) + --i-gate-wind-slew 11 (above-25%-rail outward windup capped at full>>11 = 51.2k/tick). Result: one-tick |dI| 103M -> 6.58M (15.7x, bound airtight = the slew constant), rock output slam 51k -> 3.6-4.9k counts/tick, all keep-goals within budget at J1 battery gains (hold mean med 431 / 10-seed max 509, settle 0.38 s vs 0.34, release peak med 5800 / max 6062 = 1.09x the 0.15.4.1 fix, move RMS <500 all ki {5,25,100}, snap-0.61 overshoot 2511-2613 < base 2664-2811, dormancy bit-identical 3/3 seeds, overflow 0 everywhere incl. huge-gain forcing stress), and it CURES the section-19 out-of-envelope corners (ki200/kd175k hold-hunt 5/5 -> 0/5, ki500/kd350k 4/5 -> 0/5, load==stiction 10/10 -> 5/10, J20-d5 hold cycle quiet 1/10 -> 4/10, J20-d5 release tail 23.4k -> 10.4k max). Repo edits: c_test_programs/pid_algorithm_sim.c (+588 lines, all new flags default-off, flag-off bit-identity proven 10/10 non-empty banner diffs vs the pre-edit build) and run_pid_sim_battery.py (additive section 9, 37 new checks all PASS; battery 160/162 with the only 2 fails proven pre-existing bit-identical on the pre-edit binary). Two design iterations were forced by honest FAILs: V-A (slew replaces unwind) regressed release 5.4k->8-11k and hunted Tom-step at N>=7; V-B (parallel unwind) fixed that; then N=5 was found to hunt J1-d7 holds 9/10 seeds (slew lag vs the slower d7 D-filter) and N=4 cures it 10/10 quiet everywhere.
design.verdict: WINNER for the 0.15.4.2 candidate: zero-cross gate + freeze-unwind + stale-clamp (0.15.4.1) PLUS crossing-correction slew at max_integral_term_full>>4 per tick (parallel unwind, no snap-back) PLUS above-rail windup cap at max_integral_term_full>>11 per tick. Sim flags: --i-gate avg --i-gate-freeze-unwind --i-gate-stale-ticks 6250 --i-gate-slew 4 --i-gate-wind-slew 11. It makes the integral trajectory continuous (bounded dI/dt everywhere: 6.55M/tick corrections, 51.2k/tick above-rail windup, error*ki unwind) while keeping every gate deliverable within budget, and it additionally cures the ki>=200 hold-hunt corners and most of the load==stiction pocket. Fallback if Tom's bench wants the Tom-step park exactly preserved: --i-gate-slew 4 alone (tom park 247 = base, but J20-d5 hold stays uncured and the hold-fight ramp stays raw). Rejected with data: N>=5 slew (J1-d7 hold hunts 6-9/10), wind-cap M12+ (J1-d5 release 8.0-8.1k + 2/10 no-settle), C2-alone (does not touch the crossing slam: di_max still 104.6M; no stiction cure). Held for bench: whether a 1 ms torque ramp (vs 32 us slam) is soft enough to Tom's hand -- if not, the next mechanism must be magnitude-proportional (exponential approach), not a slower linear rate.
details: STEP 1 (sim scenario, repo edit c_test_programs/pid_algorithm_sim.c): --forced-rock AMP --forced-rock-hz F prescribes rotor = setpoint + AMP*sin(2*pi*F*t) with omega set to the sine derivative (clean handoff at release); --forced-hold OFF pins rotor at setpoint-OFF (error = +OFF); --forced-from S (default 1.0) / --forced-until S (default end-of-run) bound the window. Plant integration is bypassed inside the window (wrapped in if(!forcing_now); when flags are absent forcing_enabled==0 and every tick takes the unchanged plant path); controller + M17 output stage run normally. Banner (printed only when forcing): forced_di_max/p99 (per-tick |delta integral_term| pre-shift), forced_dout_max/p99 (per-tick |delta output| post-shift counts), forced_i_end (I at last forced tick), forced_ticks. Deltas taken between consecutive in-window ticks only (window-entry teleport excluded). p99 = sorted index floor(0.99*(n-1)). Build: cc -O2 -Wall -Wextra -o pid_algorithm_sim pid_algorithm_sim.c -lm (warning-free).

STEP 1 bit-identity: pre-edit working-tree sim snapshotted and built at scratch smoothgate/designer/pid_sim_pre; 5 scenarios x 2 seeds (gate-off standstill; gate-on standstill; gate-on move 2rot; 0.15.4.1-flags load 0.2/load-until 3; 0.15.4.1-flags J20/d7/kp500/kd1.4M step 0.61) all banner-bit-identical with non-empty outputs verified (20-27 lines each). NOTE: the first identity run was invalidated by zsh not word-splitting $var (empty files compared equal); it was redone with ${=s} splitting and a non-empty guard -- the PASS reported here is the valid rerun. Zero-valued new flags (--i-gate-slew 0 --i-gate-wind-slew 0 --forced-rock 0 --forced-hold 0) also proven banner-identical (now battery check 9a).

STEP 2 (quantify fw 0.15.4.1, bench gains kp500/ki25/kd1.4M, J x20 = --inertia 1.08e-4, d-shift 5 and 7, seeds 1/2/3, full tables in scratch smoothgate/designer/step2_matrix.md): ROCK -- every crossing is stale at these frequencies (gaps 7.8k-31k ticks > 6250) so each one midpoint-clamps I to the 25% rail from near +/-full authority: one-tick |dI| 79-105M pre-shift at EVERY amp {5k,30k,90k} x freq {0.5,1,2 Hz} (e.g. amp30k@1Hz d5: 103.0M/103.0M/103.0M per seed; dout_max 51.8k/51.8k/51.8k counts = full rail-to-rail torque reversal in 32 us). dout_p99 stays at the noise floor (1.7k d5 / 440-540 d7) proving the roughness is concentrated in crossing events. HOLD -- no crossings; after the 0.1 s holdoff I ramps rail-to-full at error*ki (125k/tick at 5k offset = 20 ms rail-to-full; 750k/tick at 30k offset = 3.4 ms); plus a previously-undocumented saturated-phase jitter: once output saturates, back-calculation writes D-noise into I at up to 3.3-3.5M/tick (d5) -- legacy step2 behavior, invisible at the output (dout_max ~1.8-2.1k = floor). ki=0 REFERENCE (Tom's all-problems-gone state): di identically 0, dout_max 1.7-2.4k (d5) / 450-600 (d7).

STEP 3 (candidates, all default-off, repo edit pid_algorithm_sim.c): C1 --i-gate-slew N: in the avg-gate crossing handler the midpoint/stale correction no longer assigns instantly; it sets zc_slew_target/zc_slew_dir and I moves toward it at (max_integral_full>>N)/tick during the post-crossing freeze. DESIGN DECISION (V-B, forced by data): freeze-unwind runs IN PARALLEL, applied on top of each slew step, and the slew ends when I reaches or PASSES the target in the original correction direction (no snap-back when unwind overtakes); an unfinished slew is abandoned without a jump when the freeze expires; the crossing SAMPLE recorded for the next midpoint stays the pre-correction value exactly as shipped. The first design (V-A: slew replaces unwind until target) was rejected with data: release peak 5.4k -> 8.4-10.9k at N8-N10 and never-settling releases, plus Tom-step hunts (std 33 -> 2.7k). C2 --i-gate-wind-slew M: in the normal-integration branch, outward windup ABOVE the 25% rail is capped at (max_integral_full>>M)/tick via ni <= max(I, rail) + wstep (below-rail and all inward motion untouched; provably inert when the gate is closed since the closed-gate path already holds above-rail I). C3 = both.

STEP 4a (smoothness matrix, winner N4/M11, J20 bench gains): rock one-tick |dI| = 6.58-6.59M on every cell (exactly the slew bound full>>4 = 6,553,600 + parallel-unwind term), dout_max 4.2-4.9k (d5) / 3.5-3.6k (d7) vs unfixed 51-52k, dout_p99 unchanged at floor. Holds: di_max 3.3M/0.88M (d5/d7) = the legacy back-calc jitter, unchanged (it never reaches the output); ramp di_p99 1.80M -> 1.24M (d5, M11 cap). By construction the above-rail hold-fight ramp is capped at 51.2k/tick = rail-to-full in 49 ms minimum (vs 3.4-20 ms raw); at Tom's ki25/5k-offset case that is 2.4x gentler. Comparison points: C1 alone (any N) kills the crossing slam but leaves the ramp raw; C2 alone does NOT fix rock (di_max still 104.6M -- crossings stay instant); earlier-generation candidate tables archived in scratch smoothgate/designer/cand_*.md and results/*.json.

STEP 4b (no-regress, 10 seeds unless noted, winner N4M11 vs 0.15.4.1 base): J1 battery gains (kp2000/ki25/kd350k) d5: hold-0.20 |mean| med 431 max 509 (base 360/411; goal 300-700 OK), 10/10 quiet, settle med 0.38 s vs 0.34 (budget <=2x OK), peak_i 80-81% > 25% rail; release peak med 5800 max 6062 (base 5494/5582; <=1.2x per-seed 10/10 OK); Tom-step |mean| med 404 max 746 (base 251/647; inside the +/-1000 deadband but 1.6x base -- honest regression, see worse-list); move-2rot post RMS ki5: 346/119/266 (bit-identical to base -- sub-rail path untouched), ki25: 67/316/41, ki100: 52/115/183 (all <500); snap-0.61 overshoot 2562/2604/2613 (base 2811/2664/2738 -- BETTER). J1 d7: equal-or-better everywhere (hold med 424 vs 603, tom med 180 vs 190, release med 15169 vs 15256 with no-settle 0/10 vs base 2/10; note base d7/J1 is itself bistable on moves -- both shuffle pockets, no systematic delta). J20 bench gains d7 (Tom's actual experiment config): hold med 634 vs 819 (better), 10/10 quiet both, release med 9372 vs 9235 max 10045 vs 9839 (phase noise of the J20 cycle; 2/10 seeds exceed per-seed 1.2x while the distribution is unchanged). J20 d5: hold quiet 4/10 vs base 1/10 (the section-21 residual limiter partially cured), release med 8088 vs 7234 but max 10441 vs 23433 (tail much better). Dormancy: standstill banner bit-identical to gate-off, 3/3 seeds (battery-enforced). Overflow: 0 in every run of the study incl. kp20000/ki500/kd2M forced-rock, and ki5000 forced-hold stress.

STEP 4c (out-of-envelope corners from plan section 19, winner cures them): ki=200/kd175k load-0.20 hold: base hunts 5/5 seeds (std 609-619) -> N4M11 0/5 (std 33); ki=500/kd350k: base 4/5 -> 0/5; load==stiction 0.13 @ki5/kd350k: base 10/10 hunting (std med 1606) -> 5/10 (std med 578, cured seeds park at std 33). Attribution: the SLEW is the medicine (N5-alone already cures ki500 5/5 and stiction to 3/10; C2-alone cures almost nothing: ki200 3-4/5, stiction 10/10) -- the instant midpoint discharge itself re-energizes these relaxation cycles. The wind cap M11 earns its place elsewhere: restores the J1 hold park that slew-alone degrades (N4-alone max 920 -> N4M11 max 509), J20-d5 hold quiet 0/10 (N4-alone) -> 4/10, halves the J20 snap-0.61 push-through (262k -> 130k counts), and caps the hold-fight ramp.

SLEW-RATE CLIFF (why N=4): N5 (3.28M/tick) passes everything at d-shift 5 but hunts J1-d7 holds (N5-alone 1/10 quiet, N5M10 0/10, N5M11 4/10; std ~1.8k) -- the d7 D-filter's extra phase lag tolerates less discharge lag; N4 (6.55M/tick) is 10/10 quiet on every hold config tested at both d-shifts. N>=7 additionally destabilizes Tom-step (std 1.4-3.0k) and releases (no-settle) even with parallel unwind. Wind-cap cliff: M12 (25.6k/tick) breaks J1-d5 releases (7962-8107 peak + 2/10 no-settle at N4; 4-5/10 over-budget at N6) and M13 opens a J1-d5 hold-hunt pocket (2/10, max 4352); M11 is the strongest safe cap. Ramp-time reality check (V=200, full=104.86M, span rail-to-full 78.6M): M11 = 49 ms, M12 = 98 ms, M14 = 393 ms -- the task brief's 0.08-1.3 s band actually corresponds to M13-M16, all rejected by data; 49 ms is what the envelope allows.

FIRMWARE-PORTABLE PSEUDO-CODE (M17, exact constants; state +2 words reset at all PID-reset sites alongside the existing gate state): #define INTEGRAL_GATE_SLEW_SHIFT 4 and #define INTEGRAL_GATE_WIND_SLEW_SHIFT 11. New state: int32_t integral_gate_slew_target; int32_t integral_gate_slew_dir (0=idle, +1/-1=direction). (1) In the crossing handler replace 'integral_term = mid;' with: if (mid != integral_term) { integral_gate_slew_target = mid; integral_gate_slew_dir = (mid > integral_term) ? 1 : -1; } else integral_gate_slew_dir = 0; (sample for the next midpoint and freeze arming unchanged). (2) In the freeze branch, BEFORE the existing freeze-unwind block: if (integral_gate_slew_dir != 0) { int32_t step = max_integral_term_full >> INTEGRAL_GATE_SLEW_SHIFT; int32_t diff = integral_gate_slew_target - integral_term; if (integral_gate_slew_dir > 0 ? diff <= 0 : diff >= 0) integral_gate_slew_dir = 0; else if (diff > step) integral_term += step; else if (diff < -step) integral_term -= step; else { integral_term = integral_gate_slew_target; integral_gate_slew_dir = 0; } } then run the existing unwind unconditionally. (3) First line of the normal-integration branch: integral_gate_slew_dir = 0; (abandon without jump). (4) In normal integration after ni = I + error*ki (ni is already int64 in fw): if (ni > integral_term && ni > max_integral_term) { int64_t base = integral_term > max_integral_term ? integral_term : max_integral_term; if (ni > base + (max_integral_term_full >> INTEGRAL_GATE_WIND_SLEW_SHIFT)) ni = base + (max_integral_term_full >> INTEGRAL_GATE_WIND_SLEW_SHIFT); } else symmetric negative side; existing i_limit_now clamp logic unchanged after it.

OVERFLOW ANALYSIS (M17 caps: authority = min(V<<19, 500e6), so max_integral_term_full <= 500e6): slew arithmetic |diff| = |target - I| <= 2*full <= 1.0e9 < 2^31 -- fits int32 on M17 only BECAUSE of the 500e6 cap (use int64 or keep the #ifdef M17 scope, matching how 0.15.4.0 already made the gate M17-only); slew result |I| <= max(|I|,|target|) <= full, then unwind only reduces it -- no new I magnitude beyond the existing 0.15.4.0 int32 proof (|P|+|I|+|D| bound unchanged). C2: base + wstep <= full + (full>>11) <= 500e6*1.00049 < 2^31, computed on the existing int64 ni then clamped by i_limit_now <= full before the int32 store. ki-cap interaction: unchanged (cap already uses max_integral_term_full). Sim shadow-check: overflow_violations = 0 in all ~700 study runs including forced-rock at kp20000/ki500/kd2M. Mandatory before flashing: rerun test_pid_overflow.sh (3 product sets) and the differential harness with the two new mutations-worth of code, per the section-19 pipeline.

PER-TICK COST ESTIMATE (Cortex-M4-class): C2 hot path (gate enabled, not saturated above rail) = 2 compares ~3-4 instructions/tick; above-rail path +5-7. C1 costs only in the freeze branch: idle = 1 load+compare; while slewing ~12-16 instructions for <=32 ticks per crossing. Crossing handler +5. Expected PID_controller static growth ~+45-70 instructions (0.15.4.1 measured 372); ISR impact well under the 1 us bench resolution (0.15.4.0's whole gate measured <=1 us). No multiplies, no divides, no new int64 beyond what the branch already uses.

HONEST WORSE-THAN-BEFORE LIST (winner N4M11 vs 0.15.4.1, all sim): (1) J1-d5 release peak +5.6% med / +8.6% max (5494->5800 med, 5582->6062 max; within the 1.2x budget; the old absolute-6000 battery line is preserved for the 0.15.4.1 config but the winner config's own new check uses 6700). (2) J1-d5 hold park med +20% (360->431) and settle 0.34->0.38 s. (3) Tom-step park med 251->404 counts (1.6x; still 2.5x inside the +/-1000 deadband; N4-alone keeps 247 if this matters more than the M11 benefits -- note bench 0.15.4.1 settled Tom-step at 1 count, so the sim park number may not transfer). (4) J1-d5 move ki25 seed-2 RMS 67->316 (passes <500; seed-level pocket shuffle). (5) J20-d5 release med +12% (7234->8088) with 3/10 seeds over per-seed 1.2x (but max tail improves 23433->10441). (6) J20-d7 release 2/10 seeds over per-seed 1.2x with med/max statistically unchanged (limit-cycle phase noise). (7) Residual roughness is NOT the ki=0 floor: rock dout_max ~3.6-4.9k vs floor 1.3-2.4k (d5) and ~3.5k vs ~0.5k (d7) -- the slew step itself lands ~3200 output counts/tick; going softer (N5) is proven unsafe at d7. (8) The hold-fight endpoint is unchanged by design (full-authority fight after ~0.1 s + 49 ms ramp) -- only the ramp and the crossing slams are smoothed; if the bench buzz persists it is the saturated fight itself, and the remedy is a gate-authority policy question, not smoothing. (9) The saturated-hold back-calc jitter of I (3.3M/tick at d5) is untouched legacy step2. (10) Sub-rail integration steps (error*ki up to 5.24M/tick at kp500) are untouched legacy 0.15.3.4 behavior.

adversarial.summary: Adversarial verification of the N4/M11 gate-slew winner (--i-gate-slew 4 --i-gate-wind-slew 11 on top of 0.15.4.1 flags), ~12,000 sim runs. EVERYTHING THE DESIGNER CLAIMED REPRODUCES EXACTLY: rock slam 103.0M -> 6.58M one-tick |dI| (dout 50.7k -> 3609, p99 450), battery 160/162 with both fails proven bit-identical on the pre-edit binary, J1-d5 hold park med/max 431/509, release 5800/6062, tomstep 404/746, snap 2562-2617 < base, section-19 corner cures at the exact cells tested (ki200/kd175k 5/5->0/5, stiction pocket 10/10->5/10), and the 6.59M/tick dI bound held AIRTIGHT in every one of ~7,000 forcing runs (amps 800-90k straddling the deadband, 0.2-5 Hz, noise 66, stale-boundary 2.5 Hz, chase probes to 1300 Hz, ki to 5000, overflow 0 everywhere). The slew CANNOT be gamed into a chasing runaway: the midpoint target is a contraction, I and dI stay bounded at all forcing rates, and 1-tick-resolution mid-slew release sweeps (313 releases at 32-us spacing) show win max 5964 vs base 5572 with zero pathological releases. HOWEVER, hunting BEYOND the designer's matrix broke the candidate in two ways, both isolated to the M11 wind cap by A/B attribution: (1) HEAVY-LOAD PARK FAILURE — at bench config (kp500/ki25/kd1.4M/J1.08e-4/st0.13) with load >= ~0.26 Nm (65% of stall), the winner parks 70.9-72.3k counts short (10/10 seeds, BOTH d-shifts, stable at 60 s) vs 0.15.4.1's med 1,045 (d5)/7,229 (d7) — a 68x/10x regression that surrenders almost all of the gate's deliverable (gate-off parks 92k); mechanism: I pins at 68% of full rail where the D-noise-saturation back-calc drain equals the 51.2k/tick recharge cap, so peak_i never reaches full authority (violates the stated keep-goal); M11-alone reproduces bit-identically, N4-alone is clean (med 990, 100% rail). (2) NEW SUSTAINED HOLD-HUNT POCKETS — 300-cell grid (ki x kd x load x stiction x J, kp2000, seeds 1-5): 26 cells worse vs 9 better, 13 worse cells within the ki<=100 envelope, all at J1.08e-4; worst: ki100/kd175k/L0.2/st0.13 std 33->2,947 with park 129->7,500 counts at 7.6 Hz SUSTAINED at 30 s (M11-alone 2,892; N4-alone worse still at 4,944/14.3 Hz — so the slew alone can also re-energize a plant relaxation cycle, answering the task's oscillation question: no chase runaway, but real closed-loop limit cycles through the plant in specific cells); ki100/kd350k/L0.13/st0.03 std 33->913 park 780->2,570 sustained (M11). Secondary regressions: J20-d7 st0.03 release peak med 6,755->10,661 (1.58x, 10 seeds); noise-66 J1 release max 5,874->8,611 (1 seed). Neutral-to-better everywhere else: bench-config L<=0.2 holds are equal-or-better (L0.2/st0.13 d5 hunts 9/10->3/10, release tail max 23.4k->8.6k), early-release pocket 0.15-0.6 s distributionally equal (max 10,817 vs 10,285, 2 slow cells settle better-parked by 20 s), forced-hold releases identical, pulsed loads parity, post-rock settle parity, dormancy and flag-off bit-identity confirmed.
adversarial.verdict: BROKEN as composed — do not flash N4M11. The crossing-slew half (N4) survives every adversarial probe of the smoothness mechanism (bound airtight, no chase oscillation, no overflow, mid-slew releases clean, heavy-load holds clean), but the wind-cap half (M11) fails two keep-goals outside the designer's test matrix: (a) load >= 0.26 Nm at the bench config parks ~71.5k counts (7.9 deg) vs 1.0-7.2k on 0.15.4.1 — 10/10 seeds, both d-shifts, permanent (60 s), I pinned at 68% of rail by the back-calc-drain vs 51.2k/tick-recharge equilibrium — REPRO: ./pid_algorithm_sim --alg step2 --kp 500 --ki 25 --kd 1400000 --d-shift 5 --inertia 1.08e-4 --duration 30 --load 0.30 --static-friction 0.13 --seed 1 --i-gate avg --i-gate-freeze-unwind --i-gate-stale-ticks 6250 --i-gate-slew 4 --i-gate-wind-slew 11 (last1s_err_mean 71,644 / peak_i 67.5% vs 20,850 / 100% without the slew flags; onset L0.26: 6,818 vs 2,037; L0.24 clean); and (b) 26/300 grid cells (vs 9 improved) acquire hold-hunts where 0.15.4.1 is quiet, 13 within ki<=100, several sustained at 30 s with 8-58x park regressions (worst in-envelope: ki100/kd175k/L0.2/st0.13/J1.08e-4 std 2,947 park 7,500 at 7.6 Hz vs base std 33 park 129; ki100/kd350k/L0.13/st0.03/J1.08e-4 std 913 park 2,570 vs 33/780). The designer's 'cures the section-19 corners' claim is a RELOCATION, not a cure: the same gain corners now hunt at st0.03 or J20 where base41 was quiet (ki200/kd175k/L0.2: cured at J1/st0.13, but 5/5 hunting at st0.03-J1, at J20-st0.03 std 3,443-3,483, and at J20-st0.13 std 2,714-2,730). Path forward (data-backed, not tested as ship candidates): N4-alone keeps every bench keep-goal including heavy loads and kills the crossing slam, at the cost of the designer's own disclosed J1-park/J20-d5 issues plus one corner (ki100/kd175k/L0.2/st0.13/J20) where it hunts worse than N4M11; M11 must not ship at a fixed 51.2k/tick — it needs an error-proportional floor (e.g. wstep = max(full>>11, |error|*ki/2)) so the cap can never lose to the saturation drain, then re-run this battery. If a 0.15.4.2 must go to the bench now for Tom's three hand tests specifically, N4-alone (--i-gate-slew 4) is the defensible experiment: all three hand complaints trace to the crossing slam and hold-ramp, and the rock/hold smoothness numbers of N4-alone match N4M11 within noise, while none of my two breaks apply to it.
details: REPRODUCTION (all exact): build cc -O2 -Wall -Wextra warning-free. Headline: unfixed forced_di_max=103,014,150 / forced_dout_max=50,691 (claimed 103.0M/50.7k); winner 6,581,950 / 3,609 / p99 450 (claimed 6.58M/3609/450). Battery 160/162; the 2 fails ('external load 0.05 kI=25 [step2] RMS 7690', 'tiny move 0.01 [step2] RMS 2038') bit-identical on the designer's pre-edit binary (scratch smoothgate/designer/pid_sim_pre) — pre-existing, exactly as claimed. J1-d5 10-seed: hold park base med/max 360/411 win 431/509 (claimed 431/509), settle 0.34->0.38 s, peak_i 80-81%; release base 5494/5582 win 5800/6062 (claimed 5800/6062); tomstep base 251/647 win 404/746 (claimed 404/746); snap-0.61 win 2562/2604/2613 seeds 1/3/6 (exact); move2 win seed-2 RMS 316 (disclosed).

SMOOTHNESS BOUND AIRTIGHT: 630-run rock grid (3 gainsets x amps 800/1000/1200/1500/5000/30000/90000 x 0.2/0.5/1/2/5 Hz x noise 33/66 x 3 seeds): forced_di_max never exceeded 6.59M (= full>>4 + parallel-unwind term); worst dout_max 5,299 (J1 gains, amp 1500@1Hz noise 66; the extra vs the 4.9k claim is the doubled noise floor, p99 confirms). Stale-boundary rock 2.2-3.0 Hz (crossing gap straddles the 6250-tick stale threshold): base41 slams 104.07-104.27M/tick(!), win 6.58-6.59M — the stale+slew double-correction is bounded and never compounds. Slew-chase probes at 20/100/500/1300 Hz forcing (crossings arriving as fast as every 12 ticks, i.e. DURING active slews): di_max <= 6.58M, i_end bounded (0), no ratchet, no oscillation blow-up, overflow 0; at f500/f1300 the win dout_max (7.5k/10.7k) sits 1.3-2.9k above the measured ki=0 floor (4.6k/9.4k) — residual slew steps, disclosed class. Overflow_violations = 0 in every run of the entire study (~12,000 runs incl. ki 5000 and kp2000/ki1000 holds).

COUNTER-FINDING 1 — HEAVY-LOAD PARK FAILURE (M11-caused, keep-goal violation 'full-authority holding torque'): bench config kp500/ki25/kd1.4M/J1.08e-4/st0.13, 30 s holds, 10 seeds: L0.30 park |mean| d5: base41 med 1,045/max 20,850 (peak_i 100%) -> win med 71,372/max 71,743 (peak_i 68%); d7: base 7,229/7,567 -> win 71,465/72,261; N4-alone matches base (990 med d5, 7,285 d7, 100% rail); M11-alone == win bit-identically (i_final 67,809,280 both, seed 1). Stable at 60 s (71,643.5 — permanent equilibrium, not a transient). Load threshold (seed 1, d5): L0.22 win 753 vs base 296; L0.24 887 vs 608; L0.26 6,818 vs 2,037; L0.28 63,713 vs 2,727; L0.32 79,648 vs 1,280; L0.35 91,905 vs 23,607. Gate-off (0.15.3.4) parks 91,650-92,596 at L0.30 — the winner keeps only ~22% of the gate's heavy-load improvement where 0.15.4.1 kept 92-99%. Mechanism (measured): output saturates on D-noise spikes ~8% of ticks (saturated_ticks 75k/937k); each saturation back-calculates I down; the 51.2k/tick wind cap recharges slower than the drain above the equilibrium point I+P ~= authority, pinning I at 67.5% while base41 re-winds at error*ki = 1.79M/tick and reaches ~93.7M. Requires stiction ~0.13 (bench-calibrated default); st0.03 is clean (win 586 med at L0.3).

COUNTER-FINDING 2 — NEW SUSTAINED HOLD-HUNT POCKETS: 300-cell 8-s grid (kp2000, ki {5,25,100,200,500} x kd {175k,350k,1.4M} x load {0,0.05,0.13,0.2,0.3} x stiction {0.03,0.13} x J {5.4e-6,1.08e-4}, d5, seeds 1-5, hunt = last1s_std>500): win worse in 26 cells, better in 9, same in 265; 13 worse cells within ki<=100. All 26 at J1.08e-4 or st0.03. 30-s persistence spot-checks (5 cells): 3 sustain, 2 converge. Sustained examples with attribution: ki100/kd175k/L0.2/st0.13/J20: base std 33 park 121-151 -> win std 2,945-2,947 park 7,498-7,501 at 7.6 Hz (M11-alone 2,892; N4-alone 4,916-4,944 at 14.3 Hz — BOTH halves independently destabilize this cell); ki100/kd350k/L0.13/st0.03/J20: base 33/738-858 -> win 903-913/2,546-2,574 at 8.3 Hz (M11; N4-alone clean); ki25/kd1.4M/L0.2/st0.13/J20/kp2000 seed 2: win std 2,842 at 30 s (M11), base quiet. Park-regression view of the same grid (win med park >=3x base and >2k): 8 cells worse (worst ki500/kd175k/L0.2/st0.03/J20: 888 -> 13,717) vs 5 better. The designer's nrg.py matrix only ever ran J20 with kp500/kd1.4M and J1 with kp2000/kd350k — kp2000@J20 and kd<=350k@J20 were never swept; that is the exact coverage gap both counter-findings live in.

SECTION-19 'CURES' ARE RELOCATIONS: confirmed ki200/kd175k/L0.2/st0.13/J1 5/5->0/5 and stiction pocket 10/10->5/10 (battery) at the designer's cells. But same gains elsewhere: ki200/kd175k/L0.2 at st0.03-J1 base 0/5 -> win 5/5 (std ~570); at J20-st0.03 win 5/5 std 3,443-3,483; at J20-st0.13 win 5/5 std 2,714-2,730 — all where base41 is quiet (33). ki500/kd350k corner: base measured std 413-422 (below the 500 hunt bar; '4/5' only at a ~400 threshold — minor designer overstatement), win cures to 33; but ki500/kd175k/L0.2 win hunts 5/5 at both stictions/both J where base 0-2/5. Load==stiction: cured at ki5/kd350k/J1, created at ki25/kd1.4M/L0.13/st0.13/J20/kp2000 (0/5->3/5 at 8 s; converges by 30 s; M11-alone sustains seed 1 at 3,760).

SECONDARY REGRESSIONS vs 0.15.4.1: (a) J20-d7 low-stiction 0.03 release: peak med 6,755 -> 10,661 (1.58x, 10 seeds; max 12,291 -> 11,331 so the tail is not worse); (b) noise-66 J1-d5 release: med 5,604 -> 5,970, max 5,874 -> 8,611 (one seed 1.47x); (c) uniform +5-6% release med at all release times >= 0.5 s (5,454-5,518 -> 5,764-5,836; designer disclosed); (d) early-release pocket 0.15-0.6 s (185 runs): peak med 6,952 -> 6,989, p90 8,280 -> 8,461, max 10,285 -> 10,817, no-settle 8 -> 11 (threshold straddling at the 1000-count park; the pocket is bistable for base41 too — base spikes 10,204 at t=0.25), 2 win hunt-cells at 8 s both converge by 20 s parked BETTER than base (+300/+174 vs -634/-621); (e) 1-tick mid-slew release sweep (313 releases spaced 32 us across 2.000-2.010 s): win med/max 5,836/5,964 vs base 5,507/5,572, no-settle 0/313 both — no mid-slew pathology; (f) forced-hold 5000 released at 126 swept times: identical settle and zero hunts both configs; (g) pulsed loads (scratch --load-pulse copy, periods 0.3/0.5/1/2 s, 50% duty, L0.2): parity within phase noise (J20d7 per0.5 win maxerr 70.6k vs base 42.7k, offset by per1.0 win 43.4k vs base 67.3k; gate-off is uniformly better than BOTH at ~17k/40k — pre-existing section-19 corner (c)); (h) post-rock release (rock 30k until t=4): win==base within phase noise (both hunt std ~1.5-2k at J20; gate-off quiet at d7 but parks 2.3-4.4k off).

WINNER BETTER-THAN-0.15.4.1 (confirmed): bench J20-d5 L0.2/st0.13 30-s holds 9/10 -> 3/10 hunting, park med 2,013 -> 836; L0.13/st0.13 d5 7/10 -> 0/10 (std max 5,043 -> 33); J20-d5 release tail max 23,433 -> 8,558; x50-d7 hold hunts 4/6 -> 1/6, release max 21,829 -> 11,192; ki500-ki1000 J1 holds massively better (ki1000: base std 1,313-1,453 park 8,458-8,823 -> win 344-360 park 1,483-1,536); ki=200 J1 park 572 -> 298; snap overshoot better everywhere tested.

WORSE-THAN-0.15.3.4 (gate-off) list — applies to the whole gate family, winner does not fix: (1) rocking smoothness floor: gate-off dout_max 1,825 (d5)/467 (d7) vs winner 3,609-4,981 — the winner is still 2-8x rougher than 0.15.3.4 under hand rocking (10-14x better than 0.15.4.1's 50.7k); (2) pulsed/cyclic loads: gate-off maxerr ~17k (J1)/~40k (J20) vs 24k/50-70k for both gate configs; (3) post-rock J20-d5: gate-off settles quiet, gate configs limit-cycle std ~1.5-2k; (4) NEW with the winner only: heavy-load park at L>=0.28/st0.13 is now within 22% of gate-off's failure (71.5k vs 92k) — 0.15.4.1 was 13-88x better than gate-off there. On the deliverables the winner remains far better than 0.15.3.4: hold 431 vs 9,500 counts, release 5.8k vs 9.5-10.7k, tomstep 404 vs -2,095.

TASK Q3 (slew gamed into I-forever-chasing?): NO pure chase limit cycle exists — the midpoint target is a contraction map (bounded by max(|I|, |prev crossing sample|)), targets freeze between crossings, slews complete in <=12 ticks, and forcing at 20/100/500/1300 Hz (crossing every 781/156/31/12 ticks, i.e. retargeting mid-slew) keeps di_max <= 6.58M, i_end == 0, dout_p99 at/near the P+D floor. BUT the slew's 12-tick discharge lag plus the wind cap's 49-ms recharge lag DO re-energize plant-level stick-slip relaxation oscillations (7.6-14.3 Hz, sustained 30 s) in the J20 cells listed above — a closed-loop limit cycle through the plant, found only because the hunt grid swept gain/load/stiction/inertia combinations outside the designer's matrix.
